branches.text: Cornered at _house2_, _guardian_ hands back the _item_ and begs you to keep the scam quiet.

outcomes.text: _child_ is free, and the Daedroth driven out of the child lies dead in _house_.
_child_ is free, though the Daedroth driven out was left loose in _house_.
The _item_ is back, and __qgiver_ knows the name of the knight who stole it.
The _item_ is back. _guardian_ got away with the scam, and with your silence.
The affair of the possessed child is settled.
The days ran out, and no one will ever know if _child_ was truly possessed.

_cousin_ is cured, and __giver_ will think the better of you for it.
You used the only root on yourself, and _cousin_ was left to the sickness.
You would not take on the healing.
